title: Section C SC-19: gasManager.ts is unreachable: getGasOptions is imported into bot.ts but never called and getGasOptionsForChain has no importer; if revived, both would bypass the fee ceilings

evidence.note: import { getGasOptions } from "./utils/gasManager"; the name occurs nowhere else in bot.ts

src: only bot.ts:3 and the two definitions; tests mock or unit-test the module (test/integration/anti-rug/botWiring.test.ts:239, test/unit/bot/exitFailedHeldResume.test.ts:161, test/unit/ethersV6BigIntArithmetic.test.ts:111/:144/:175)
getGasOptionsForChain multiplies the doubled-base maxFeePerGas by the chain multiplier and keeps the unbounded network priority fee: no ceiling, no affordability clamp
getGasOptions: legacy single-chain CONFIG.gasMultiplier and a fixed 300000 gas limit

sibling_sites_checked: All importers at the base SHA (git grep over src, scripts, test). The other dead TX-adjacent helper, maybeApproveForChain (bot.ts:222-229, no caller), is in the BUY slice file; the dead legacy safety helpers are AUD-BUY-026.
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: no production caller, so no behaviour; recorded because a revived call would bypass the CR-01 fee-ceiling fix and the test suite exercises it as if it were live. Section C candidate (no RC), origin research-candidate with an empty rc list.
recommendation: Phase 25 dead-code deletion (with its unit test and the two mocks), after knip confirms no dynamic caller.
